generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent game sprite animation sheet, Eula elemental skill I, a FAN OF FROST CRYSTALS released by a lateral empty-hand casting gesture while keeping heavy claymore low.
Create a NEW exact12-frame animation sheet,4columns3rows left-to-right top-to-bottom,4:3 canvas, genuine native RGBA transparency. Reference image idle.png is Eula's precise adult character identity, costume, rendering and weapon proportions ONLY. Preserve light icy-blue short layered hair with decorative blue feather/ribbon, blue-white asymmetric cape with pale snowflake pattern, black fitted bodysuit, gold filigree, white-and-blue detached sleeves, black gloves, long dark thigh-high boots with elegant heels. Mature elegant adult anatomy and exquisite detailed Japanese anime painted art. Same broad heavy blue-silver greatsword with ornate gold star/snowflake crossguard, rigid straight blade; do not turn it into a thin rapier. Facing RIGHT in mild three-quarter side view.

THIS IS FROST ELEMENTAL CASTING, NOT A SWORD ATTACK. The sword stays at LOW DIAGONAL GUARD below waist throughout ALL12 frames, heavy blade pointing diagonally down RIGHT near the ground, right hilt held close to hip. No thrust, no overhead raise, no uppercut or rotational cleave. It stays supported by firm body stance while her EMPTY LEFT hand gathers frost above the blade then opens SIDEWAYS toward front-right to release a fan. The casting left palm ends facing outward/right with thumb uppermost, a horizontal wrist turn and lateral opening; not an upward scoop and not a downward pressing decree. No actual ice projectiles painted on sheet because the game renders them.

Eula moves with poised dance-like weight transfer and elegant shoulders while respecting greatsword weight. Feet modestly staggered, not both together, no deep crouch or aggressive lunge. Subtle turn of hip/torso toward target during release, then return.

01: composed low claymore guard angled down-right, weight on rear leg, forward toe lightly poised; left hand rests near grip.
02: release empty left hand from grip and move it just ABOVE low blade, fingers softly curved, elbow inward, slight torso gather; right sword hand remains near hip.
03: left palm hovers over lower blade near waist gathering frost, elbow close, wrist inward, head focused right; sword unchanged low.
04: turn empty left wrist toward front-right with palm edge now nearly vertical ready to open a fan, forearm still collected; right claymore stays low.
05 FIRST CONTACT AND RELEASE: make one small poised forward step and clearly OPEN empty left arm outward toward screen-right at lower-chest height; palm faces outward/right, fingers spread like an opening fan, thumb uppermost. Spell has ALREADY launched in this pose. Claymore stays down-right beside hips with only a tiny guiding pivot, not forward stabbing.
06: maximum lateral empty-arm opening and horizontal wrist turn, graceful square shoulder opening, stable heel planted; right greatsword remains heavy low diagonal guard, no raised blade.
07: sustain outward fan-casting palm briefly, soften left elbow slightly as recoil arrives, cape shows small delayed sideways motion.
08: hold a calmer extended hand with fingers starting to close, shoulders begin to relax, sword still low.
09: empty left hand draws back halfway toward chest, torso turns gently toward neutral, weight gathers.
10: left hand close at chest then toward greatsword grip, claymore remains low and stable.
11: both hands return near the low hilt, compact poised weight balance, cape settling.
12: fully settled elegant low-claymore ready stance, same quiet pose family as01.

Exactly12 distinct sequential poses, consistent physical character scale, head size, limb lengths and broad greatsword length. Uniform full-body scale throughout. Use a comfortable body height about245px on1536x1152 canvas so full weapon and cape fit. Every complete head, hair, finger, heel, cape and weapon tip must be contained in its OWN cell with a minimum of24px fully transparent margin. Leave at least40px empty alpha gaps between neighboring silhouettes horizontally and vertically; never overlap cells. Keep whole blade and boots uncropped and visible. Stable local ground baseline in each row. No text, numbers, grid, border, backdrop, floor shadow, giant ice array, projectile sprites, sword trails or blue aura. At most faint tiny frost glint on the empty fingertips frames03–06; anatomy and gesture must read clearly without FX.
generations.review: Correct low-claymore/empty-hand lateral choreography, but baked hand orbs were alpha25–71 and spacing was insufficient.

generations.review: All large hand orbs removed by image_gen. Low sword throughout, lateral empty-hand fan release in first contact frame, retraction to chest then grip. Every alpha>8 pixel covered by disjoint source rectangles.
